info.name: Temenos Transact Core Banking Accounts Products API

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of records to return per page (default 25, max 100)

params.name: page_start
params.description: Page token or offset for pagination

params.name: productGroup
params.description: Filter by product group (e.g., ACCOUNTS, DEPOSITS, LOANS)

items.docs: Retrieve the product catalog including account products, deposit products, loan products, and card products. Returns product definitions with their conditions, eligibility criteria, and arrangement details.
